rules.sentence: A diagnosis of lymphoma is confirmed by tissue biopsy, and commonly used methods include fine-needle aspiration, core biopsy, incision/wedge biopsy, and excisional biopsy.
HL is defined by the presence of pathological Hodgkin Reed-Sternberg (HRS) cells, which are of B-cell origin on the background of nodular sclerosis, lymphocyte-predominant, or depleted stroma.
